name: Tweet
description: JSON Structure description for Sorsa tweet.

fields.name: bookmark_count
fields.description: Number of times the tweet has been bookmarked.

fields.name: conversation_id_str
fields.description: ID of the root tweet in the conversation thread.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Tweet publication date in ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: entities
fields.description: Media, links, and other embedded entities attached to the tweet.

fields.name: full_text
fields.description: Full text content of the tweet.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique tweet ID.

fields.name: in_reply_to_tweet_id
fields.description: ID of the tweet this tweet is replying to. Null if not a reply.

fields.name: in_reply_to_username
fields.description: Username of the account this tweet is replying to.

fields.name: is_quote_status
fields.description: Whether this tweet quotes another tweet.

fields.name: is_replies_limited
fields.description: Whether replies to this tweet are restricted by the author.

fields.name: is_reply
fields.description: Whether this tweet is a reply to another tweet.

fields.name: lang
fields.description: Detected language code of the tweet (e.g. `en`, `es`).

fields.name: likes_count
fields.description: Number of likes on the tweet.

fields.name: quote_count
fields.description: Number of quote tweets.

fields.name: quoted_status
fields.description: The original tweet being quoted. Present only if `is_quote_status` is true.

fields.name: reply_count
fields.description: Number of replies to the tweet.

fields.name: retweet_count
fields.description: Number of retweets.

fields.name: retweeted_status
fields.description: The original tweet being retweeted. Present only for retweets.

fields.name: user
fields.description: Author of the tweet.

fields.name: view_count
fields.description: Number of views (impressions).
